profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Avalara | Release Management & Production Support for Tax Calculation Services
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 5+ years building scalable, production-grade systems across the full stack — from C#/.NET and React to cloud infrastructure on Azure. I specialize in turning complex technical problems into reliable, maintainable solutions using Domain-Driven Design, CQRS, and Clean Architecture principles.
 
At Avalara, I own release management for core tax calculation services, coordinating deployments across environments while resolving high-priority production issues for enterprise clients. I work at the intersection of engineering and operations — diagnosing complex compliance edge cases, unblocking releases across teams, and driving automation to make deployments faster and safer.
 
Previously at PublicInput, I led architecture and delivery on custom development projects, migrated a SaaS platform to Azure Cloud, and built automated testing frameworks from the ground up. I've also led SSO integrations for government clients, mentored and helped hire engineers, and built internal documentation systems to help teams move faster.
 
I'm driven by solving hard problems well — writing clean code, designing systems that scale, and helping the people around me grow.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Release Management & DevOps

- Own release management for core tax calculation services (SOAP, TCS), coordinating deployments across sandbox and production environments
- Standardized release branch naming conventions across services, reducing deployment errors and improving cross-team consistency
- Drive cross-team release automation initiatives to streamline validation and deployment workflows

Software Engineering

- Contribute to development of a dynamic tax rules engine, including location-based logic and rules processing features
- Conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance across API, database, and calc-engine repositories
- Diagnose and resolve build and integration issues under tight release deadlines
Production Support & Incident Resolution
- Resolved a high-priority, customer-impacting defect for a major enterprise client, driving expedited fix approval and deployment
- Triage and resolve production support tickets spanning API platform, error transaction services, and tax compliance edge cases
- Investigate complex tax logic issues involving multi-state compliance (SST) and hierarchical account configurations

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with IAM, platform engineering, and observability teams to unblock releases and resolve access/infrastructure issues
- Escalate and coordinate time-sensitive fixes across engineering, support, and customer success teams

positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Enhanced an existing REST API by adding features to extend platform capabilities and meet evolving user
requirements.
• Designed and implemented solutions for custom development projects, including high-level architectural designs to meet client-specific needs.
• Migrated the SaaS solution from a single virtual machine to Azure Cloud, improving redundancy, reliability, and scalability.
• Configured and maintained CI/CD pipelines for multiple environments, ensuring efficient and reliable
deployments.
• Integrated various third-party services, including Twilio, SendGrid, Auth0, and RevAi, to enhance platform
functionality.
• Led SAML SSO integrations for government entities, collaborating with cross-functional teams.
• Optimized SQL queries to improve system performance and reduce latency.
• Delivered knowledge-sharing sessions on topics like DevOps, product management, and other tech focused topics, fostering team collaboration and growth.
• Played a key role in hiring and mentoring team members, contributing to team growth and expertise.
• Recognized internally for contributions aligned with company core values, including teamwork and innovation.
• Involved with building & architecting a UI and Unit testing automated framework (MOQ, xUnit, SpecFlow,
Playwright).
• Implemented CQRS, Domain-driven Design (DDD), SOLID principles and Clean Architecture patterns.
• Administered all Azure cloud infrastructure services (App Services, Databases, Function Apps, Application
Insights, Key Vault, API Gateway)
• Oversaw release management processes, ensuring timely and smooth delivery of updates and new features.
• Demonstrated expertise in resolving high-impact customer issues under pressure, ensuring swift problem
resolution and maintaining client satisfaction.
• Created comprehensive guides, wikis, and technical documentation to streamline processes and support team knowledge retention.
